note: Example submodule that, on install, seeds the styled_google_map_demo real_estate entity type with Sacramento CSV data and three property-type terms (Condo, Multi-Family, Residential), and ships a 'styled_google_map' View with pages /heatmap, /cluster-map, /cluster-map-spiderified, /map-controls. It cannot itself be enabled on this site because its exported View config depends on the svg_image module (not installed). Its medium/hard cases are therefore grounded in the exact live state its install produces on the (enabled) styled_google_map_demo real_estate entity type / real_estate vocabulary — verifiable with drush php:eval, no Google Maps API involved. Easy cases cover the module's paths and behavior from the docs.

evals.prompt: The styled_google_map_data submodule ships a demo View with several example map pages. What are the URL paths of those example maps?
evals.expected_output: The bundled 'styled_google_map' View exposes example pages at /heatmap, /cluster-map, /cluster-map-spiderified and /map-controls (plus a single-item display).

evals.prompt: What does the styled_google_map_data module create on install, and which property-type taxonomy terms does it add?
evals.expected_output: On install it creates three real_estate taxonomy terms (Condo, Multi-Family, Residential) with pin icons and batch-imports Sacramento property rows from csv/demo.csv into real_estate entities.

evals.prompt: Why might enabling the styled_google_map_data module fail with an unmet-dependency error, and which module must be present first?
evals.expected_output: Its exported View config (views.view.styled_google_map) depends on the svg_image module, so svg_image must be installed before styled_google_map_data can be enabled.

evals.prompt: This site has a real_estate demo property that mirrors a row the styled_google_map_data module imports. Inspect the live site and tell me the sale price of the real_estate entity named 'SGMD 3526 HIGH ST'.
evals.expected_output: The real_estate entity named 'SGMD 3526 HIGH ST' has price 59222.

evals.prompt: The styled_google_map_data module's property-type taxonomy terms have been loaded into the real_estate vocabulary on this site. Inspect the live vocabulary and list the property-type term names it contains.
evals.expected_output: The real_estate vocabulary contains the property-type terms Condo, Multi-Family and Residential.

evals.prompt: Reproduce what the styled_google_map_data module does on install: create the three property-type taxonomy terms Condo, Multi-Family and Residential in the real_estate vocabulary, and save them to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create three terms in vocabulary real_estate named Condo, Multi-Family and Residential, e.g. Term::create(['vid' => 'real_estate', 'name' => $name])->save() for each.

evals.prompt: Import one property row the way styled_google_map_data does: create a published real_estate entity named 'SGMD Sacramento Home' with price 59222 and a location point, and save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a real_estate entity name 'SGMD Sacramento Home', price 59222, status 1, with a geofield location, e.g. RealEstate::create(['name' => 'SGMD Sacramento Home', 'price' => 59222, 'status' => 1, 'location' => 'POINT (-121.43 38.63)'])->save();
